additional_info.subject: RE: ID0458509-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / NN 170000049] CableTempSensor_XD100 CRM:03056000350
additional_info.body:
Hello Milan,
The fault displayed in the error flags indicate a problem in the temperature sensors from the CCS plug.
I took a look on it and confirmed that one PT1000 is not reporting any value.
There are two options, or the PT1000 inside CCS plug is defective and showing no values or there is a loose connection. From the pictures shared that the sleeve of the cable is pulled down, when this happens could brake the temperature sensor inside the plug.
I need someone on site to measure the PT1000 resistors from CCS to confirm if is broken or not. The brown cable can be isolated with heat shrink tubing if we conclude that the Plug is fine.
If you want already take a spare CCS with you, the MLFB is 8EM5903-0AA01-6AA5. It's still available in the spare parts list.
If you need any additional information feel free to reach out to me.
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
